mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5% signals labor market tightness, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of high GDP demand (GDPC1 > 20,000) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signals strong economic expansion, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite meeting the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: During late-stage monetary tightening cycles, rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal potential over-tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-stage tightening cycles despite rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly job growth (PAYEMS) above trend signals labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS shows sustained monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the supply index (INDPRO) exceeds 95, indicating potential oversupply or weak demand, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 95.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of high GDP demand (GDPC1 > 20,000) and strong labor demand (HOUST > 900) signals robust economic activity, driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite meeting the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment environment (UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 130,000), strong labor market conditions and corporate confidence drive positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS > 130000.
